title: Initialize Centrality Scores
description: Set harmonic centrality H(v) = 0 for all nodes v. These will accumulate the sum of reciprocal distances from each source node.

title: For Each Source Node: BFS/SSSP
description: For each node s as source: run BFS (unweighted) or Dijkstra (weighted) to compute the shortest distance dist(s, v) to every other node v. Nodes unreachable from s have distance = ∞.

title: Compute Reciprocal Distances
description: For each reachable node v ≠ s, compute 1 / dist(s, v). Unreachable nodes contribute 0 (since 1/∞ = 0). This is the key difference from Closeness — disconnectedness is handled naturally.

title: Accumulate Harmonic Sum
description: Add all reciprocal distances to the source's score: H(s) += Σ_{v ≠ s} 1 / dist(s, v). This sum is the harmonic centrality of node s.

title: Normalize Scores (Optional)
description: Divide by (n-1) to get the average reciprocal distance. This normalizes scores to [0, 1] range where 1 means directly connected to all other nodes.
